metadata.title: Agent API graph directory
metadata.authorityBoundary: Deterministic public-source joins only. Exact IDs and source-declared relationships are authoritative; normalized-label and account-title joins are explicitly derived and never presented as universal federal crosswalks.

entities.label: U.S. Special Operations Command mission
entities.claim: USSOCOM headquarters at MacDill Air Force Base develops and provides special operations forces and capabilities for national defense.

entities.label: U.S. Special Operations Command published budget portfolio
entities.claim: Published budget sponsorship covers 68 retained defense program records.

entities.label: House Armed Services Subcommittee on Cyber, Information Technologies, and Innovation jurisdiction
entities.claim: Department of Defense policy related to the acquisition of computer software, the electromagnetic spectrum, and electromagnetic warfare; and Department of Defense policy and programs and accounts related to artificial intelligence, cyber security, cyber operations, cyber forces, information technology, and science and technology (including defense-wide programs and accounts related to research, development, testing, and evaluation, except for those defense-wide programs and accounts related to research, development, testing, and evaluation of missile defense systems).

entities.label: Defense Logistics Agency published budget portfolio
entities.claim: Published budget sponsorship covers 37 retained defense program records.

entities.label: House Armed Services Subcommittee on Intelligence and Special Operations jurisdiction
entities.claim: Department of Defense policy and programs and accounts related to military intelligence, national intelligence, countering weapons of mass destruction, counter-proliferation, counter-terrorism, other sensitive military operations, special operations forces, information operations policy and military information support operations, and security cooperation.

entities.label: House Armed Services Subcommittee on Strategic Forces jurisdiction
entities.claim: Department of Defense and Department of Energy policy related to strategic deterrence, strategic stability, nuclear weapons, strategic and nuclear arms control, non-proliferation, nuclear safety, missile defense, and space; Department of Defense programs and accounts related to nuclear weapons, strategic missiles, nuclear command and control systems, Department of Defense intelligence space, space systems and services of the military departments, and intermediate and long-range missile defense systems; and Department of Energy national security programs and accounts.

entities.label: Senate Appropriations Subcommittee on Defense jurisdiction
entities.claim: Defense appropriations

entities.label: Missile Defense Agency mission
entities.claim: Missile-defense development, testing, fielding and sustainment enterprise; headquarters anchor represents a geographically distributed portfolio.

entities.label: Missile Defense Agency published budget portfolio
entities.claim: Published budget sponsorship covers 57 retained defense program records.

entities.label: Defense Health Agency mission
entities.claim: Military health delivery, TRICARE and shared medical services. Agency and Defense Health Program scopes require account-level labels.

entities.label: Defense Health Agency published budget portfolio
entities.claim: Published budget sponsorship covers 26 retained defense program records.

entities.label: DARPA mission
entities.claim: Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency headquarters in Arlington.

entities.label: DARPA published budget portfolio
entities.claim: Published budget sponsorship covers 24 retained defense program records.

entities.label: 502nd Air Base Wing — Joint Base San Antonio mission
entities.claim: The 502nd Air Base Wing provides installation support across Joint Base San Antonio, including Fort Sam Houston, Lackland and Randolph.

entities.label: AFRL — Eglin Research Site mission
entities.claim: AFRL research presence at Eglin. The April 2026 enterprise redesign incorporates the former Munitions Directorate into Air Warfare; this node represents the research site, not the entire directorate.

entities.label: AFRL — Kirtland mission
entities.claim: Directed Energy and Space Vehicles directorates at Kirtland Air Force Base. AFRL announced an enterprise redesign in April 2026 without site closures or relocations; this remains a site-level record.

entities.label: AFRL — Rome Research Site mission
entities.claim: AFRL research presence at Rome. The April 2026 enterprise redesign incorporates the former Information Directorate into Information and Spectrum Warfare; this node represents the research site, not the entire directorate.

entities.label: Air Force Materiel Command mission
entities.claim: Wright-Patterson hosts Air Force headquarters responsible for materiel development, acquisition, testing and weapon-system life-cycle management.

entities.label: Alaskan Command mission
entities.claim: Alaskan Command at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson coordinates homeland defense, civil support and mission assurance within Alaska.

entities.label: Army Research Laboratory — Adelphi mission
entities.claim: DEVCOM Army Research Laboratory's Adelphi Laboratory Center.

entities.label: Coast Guard Base Portsmouth mission
entities.claim: Coast Guard support base hosting Sector Virginia and Coast Guard cutters.

entities.label: Defense Contract Audit Agency mission
entities.claim: Contract audit services and its own agency operating budget. Audited contract value is not DCAA spend.

entities.label: Defense Contract Audit Agency published budget portfolio
entities.claim: Published budget sponsorship covers 1 retained defense program records.

entities.label: Defense Contract Management Agency mission
entities.claim: Contract administration and acquisition oversight, with its own operating procurements. Contracts managed for others are not DCMA buying power.

entities.label: Defense Contract Management Agency published budget portfolio
entities.claim: Published budget sponsorship covers 1 retained defense program records.

entities.label: Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency mission
entities.claim: Personnel vetting, industrial security and enterprise security services with contracting and procurement activity.

entities.label: Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency published budget portfolio
entities.claim: Published budget sponsorship covers 5 retained defense program records.

entities.label: Defense Finance and Accounting Service mission
entities.claim: Defense finance and accounting enterprise. Payments processed for other customers are not DFAS operating budget or own procurement.

entities.label: Defense Human Resources Activity mission
entities.claim: Defense human-resources, workforce data and shared personnel-service enterprise with documented headquarters contracting.

entities.label: Defense Human Resources Activity published budget portfolio
entities.claim: Published budget sponsorship covers 5 retained defense program records.

entities.label: Defense Intelligence Agency mission
entities.claim: Defense-intelligence enterprise and Virginia Contracting Activity. Retained despite incomplete public agency-level financial disclosure.

entities.label: Defense Legal Services Agency mission
entities.claim: Legal services and adjudication support under the General Counsel. Institutional budget is distinct from procurement executed by supporting offices.

entities.label: Defense Logistics Agency Headquarters mission
entities.claim: Agency headquarters in the McNamara Headquarters Complex at Fort Belvoir.

entities.label: Defense Media Activity mission
entities.claim: Defense public communications, broadcast and public-web enterprise, with acquisition and procurement office at Fort Meade.

entities.label: Defense Microelectronics Activity mission
entities.claim: Microelectronics engineering, manufacturing support and technology acquisition with documented local contracting.

entities.label: Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency mission
entities.claim: Personnel accounting, recovery and identification mission. Pentagon headquarters anchor does not represent laboratory-specific spending.
